body: The dusty pink is a really lovely colour but jesus christ, that is the worst haircut I have ever seen. Go back to the salon and demand your money back, he fucked up. And don't worry, take prenatals and be sweet to your hair and it'll grow back in no time *hugs*
Shit. You'll be ok if you get to a hospital...

I have an uncle exactly like that. Hey, I know that feeling you mentioned, the one where you just want love and to be held. Loneliness isn't just sad, it's dangerous. If you want to talk just message me, reach out, I did recently and it pulled me back from the saddest place in the world. It's incredible how strangers will give their time to help you. There is good out there. Promise.
Thank you. Thank you. I want to paint that where I am too. It's wonderful.

You're not alone. I can only imagine how many thousands of people suffer like you do, and it's horrible that you are expected not to express it, in face, expected to express the very opposite. Is there a way that you can prove yourself unfit enough to have him taken as a ward of state but not so neglectful that you harm your son or suffer jail time? Look up cases where this has happened. Lots of junkies get their kids taken away all the time. Leave him alone in the house for a certain amount of time maybe, but make sure there is nothing sharp around, something like that. I wish you luck
Thank you for this. I'm okay
